metadata.description: ATV Starter Kit — agentic coding skills, agents, and orchestrators for GitHub Copilot CLI. See https://github.com/All-The-Vibes/ATV-StarterKit.

plugins.name: atv-agents
plugins.description: All ATV reviewer and specialist agents (universal + stack-specific).

plugins.name: atv-everything
plugins.description: ATV Starter Kit — install everything in one shot: all skills + all reviewer/specialist agents.

plugins.name: atv-pack-dev-tools
plugins.description: Developer workflow helpers — git, PR review, onboarding, todo tracking, skill scaffolding, and bug reproduction.

plugins.name: atv-pack-easter-eggs
plugins.description: Easter eggs pack — fun extras like memeIQ for AI-powered meme generation.

plugins.name: atv-pack-guidelines
plugins.description: Coding guidelines pack — Karpathy Guidelines (behavioral) plus Autoresearch (autonomous experimentation loop).

plugins.name: atv-pack-learning
plugins.description: Learning pipeline pack — Learn, Instincts, Evolve, and Observe for compounding institutional knowledge across sessions.

plugins.name: atv-pack-maintenance
plugins.description: Maintenance & health pack — atv-doctor (diagnose ATV install health) and atv-update (update marketplace plugins; advisory for project scaffold). Keep your ATV install healthy and current.

plugins.name: atv-pack-media
plugins.description: Media and cloud-storage helpers — Gemini image generation, Proof markdown collaboration, rclone file sync.

plugins.name: atv-pack-planning
plugins.description: Planning & design pack — Brainstorming, CE Brainstorm, CE Ideate, Plan, and Deepen Plan skills for shaping work before coding.

plugins.name: atv-pack-quality
plugins.description: Quality pack — Unslop and Ralph Loop for tightening up code and iterating on solutions.

plugins.name: atv-pack-review
plugins.description: Code review pack — multi-agent CE Review and document review skills for catching issues early.

plugins.name: atv-pack-security
plugins.description: Security pack — unified ATV Security skill that audits both agentic configuration and application source code (OWASP Top 10 + STRIDE).

plugins.name: atv-pack-shipping
plugins.description: Shipping & deploy pack — Takeoff, CE Work, Land, LFG/SLFG orchestrators, and CE Compound for executing and delivering work.

plugins.name: atv-pack-style
plugins.description: Opinionated coding and writing style guides — DHH Rails, Andrew Kane gems, DSPy.rb, Every style editor, frontend design.

plugins.name: atv-skill-agent-native-architecture
plugins.description: ATV `agent-native-architecture` skill — single-skill plugin (granular install). NOT standalone: some ATV skills dispatch agents bundled separately in `atv-agents`. For typical use install `atv-pack-*` (category bundle) or `atv-everything` (full kit) instead. See https://github.com/All-The-Vibes/ATV-StarterKit/blob/main/docs/marketplace.md.
